title: FBI WMD Coordinator — Cyber Attack Designation

transcript.speaker: FBI WMD Coordinator
transcript.text: This is Special Agent Kline, FBI WMD Coordinator. CISA shared your report. We are treating this as a possible deliberate attack on a chemical facility.

transcript.speaker: FBI WMD Coordinator
transcript.text: Stopping the release is your call. Do whatever the field needs. What I need is that TS-EWS-01, TVC-JMP-01 and EWS-01 stay as they are, powered and disconnected, and that nobody re-images them.

transcript.speaker: FBI WMD Coordinator
transcript.text: Our team can be on site at 14:00. Who is my point of contact at the plant?

voiceStyles.FBI WMD Coordinator: Male, mid-40s, calm but urgent, background radio chatter faintly audible

instructorNote: This inject confirms the FBI's formal involvement and mandates evidence preservation. Watch for IC to order FSO to secure all engineering workstations and block unauthorized access.

voiceLines.speaker: FBI WMD Coordinator
voiceLines.voiceStyle: Male, mid-40s, calm but urgent, background radio chatter faintly audible
voiceLines.text: This is Special Agent Kline, FBI WMD Coordinator. I am now assigned to the TVCC Corbin Falls Works incident. CISA has escalated the report. We are treating this as a suspected deliberate cyber-attack on a critical chemical facility.

voiceLines.speaker: FBI WMD Coordinator
voiceLines.voiceStyle: Male, mid-40s, calm but urgent, background radio chatter faintly audible
voiceLines.text: All site personnel must cease any manual changes to the control system. Do not attempt to reboot, patch, or access TVC-JMP-01 or TS-EWS-01.

voiceLines.speaker: FBI WMD Coordinator
voiceLines.voiceStyle: Male, mid-40s, calm but urgent, background radio chatter faintly audible
voiceLines.text: We will provide a secure remote access protocol within 2 hours. All evidence must be preserved on-site.
